<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>kotlin-jdk7-app</artifactId>
    <version>1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <kotlin.version>1.6.21</kotlin.version>
        <!-- Kotlin has no "1.7" -jvm-target value; 1.6 is the closest bytecode
             floor below 1.8 and was removed from later compilers (KT-45165 in
             1.7.0), so 1.6.21 is the last release that can actually emit it.
             kotlin-stdlib-jdk7 below is what requires the JDK 7 runtime
             (java.nio.file-based extensions), independent of the bytecode target. -->
        <kotlin.compiler.jvmTarget>1.6</kotlin.compiler.jvmTarget>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.jetbrains.kotlin</groupId>
            <artifactId>kotlin-stdlib</artifactId>
            <version>1.6.21</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.jetbrains.kotlin</groupId>
            <artifactId>kotlin-stdlib-jdk7</artifactId>
            <version>1.6.21</version>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <sourceDirectory>src/main/kotlin</sourceDirectory>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.jetbrains.kotlin</groupId>
                <artifactId>kotlin-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.6.21</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>compile</id>
                        <phase>compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>compile</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                    <execution>
                        <id>test-compile</id>
                        <phase>test-compile</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>test-compile</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

This looks complete and verified. Summary:

- **`pom.xml`**: Kotlin 1.6.21 (`kotlin-maven-plugin`, `kotlin-stdlib`, `kotlin-stdlib-jdk7`). Kotlin has no `1.7` bytecode `-jvm-target` value — `1.6` is the lowest tier below `1.8`, and it was removed from the compiler starting in Kotlin 1.7.0, so 1.6.21 is the newest release able to actually emit it. `kotlin-stdlib-jdk7` is what provides the JDK 7-specific runtime extensions (e.g. `java.nio.file`-based APIs); it's independent of the bytecode target.
- **`src/main/kotlin/Main.kt`**: minimal sample using `Closeable.use`, exercised to confirm the setup works end-to-end.
- **`.gitignore`**: excludes `target/`.

Verified by building with `JAVA_HOME` pointed at JDK 8 (the sandbox's default JDK 25 is too new for this old Kotlin compiler to even parse its version string — a build-environment limitation, not a project config issue; a real project would just build with JDK 7/8/11 as usual). Compiled `MainKt.class` and confirmed bytecode major version 50 (JVM 6 format, forward-compatible with JDK 7+) and that it runs correctly.
